caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair with upholstered seat, backrest, and armrests. The wood is a light brown color, shaped with ornate curves and cut-out decorative patterns on the arms and side supports. The upholstery is covered in a multicolored floral and scrollwork pattern, featuring large flowers in yellow, pink, red, and blue, and green leaves on a light blue background. The floral motifs are contained within a symmetrical, ornate design, highlighted by a central urn shape on the backrest. The chair casts a soft shadow to the left and slightly behind it. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a technical line sketch of the chair’s profile inside a rectangular box, and various scale measurements are labeled around the image. The artist's signature, "A. Walbeck," appears at the bottom right of the drawing. The drawing is situated within a lightly outlined rectangular border on a cream-colored background.
title: Rocking Chair
